definitions.explanation: Half of a quantity or amount. When used with clock times, it means half past the hour.

examples.japanese: {三時|さんじ}{半|はん}に{会|あ}いましょう。
examples.english: Let's meet at half past three.

examples.japanese: {半分|はんぶん}の{量|りょう}で{十分|じゅうぶん}だ。
{東京|とうきょう}から{大阪|おおさか}まで{新幹線|しんかんせん}で{二時間|にじかん}{半|はん}ぐらいかかる。
examples.english: It takes about two and a half hours from Tokyo to Osaka by bullet train.

notes:
{半|はん} means half. It is commonly attached after time expressions to mean "half past" and after counters to mean "and a half."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {三時|さんじ}{半|はん}: half past three (3:30)
- {一時間|いちじかん}{半|はん}: one and a half hours
- {半年|はんとし}: half a year; six months
- {半額|はんがく}: half price
- {半分|はんぶん}: half (as a noun)

Note: {半|はん} attached to time words means "half past," while {半分|はんぶん} is used to mean "half" as a standalone noun.
